sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run of form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw) and sit top with 22 points from 10 matches. Alsager Town, bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 games, have lost their last four matches and will present limited resistance to the promotion-chasing hosts.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second on 20 points, travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what could be a tight contest given Eccleshall's recent form (though they suffered a loss most recently). Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home, seeking to maintain pressure on the top two. In-form Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) entertain Foley Meir, with Bilston having won their last two. Barnton host Shawbury United, a clash between two mid-table sides, while struggling Crewe travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between teams in the lower half. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a battle of two of the division's lowest-scoring sides. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, who remain pointless in the league and have lost their last five matches.
